senses.definition: (transitive or intransitive or ditransitive, with person as subject) To cook (something) in an oven (for someone).
examples: I baked a delicious cherry pie.
She's been baking all day to prepare for the dinner.

senses.definition: (intransitive, with baked thing as subject) To be cooked in an oven.
(intransitive) To be warmed to drying and hardening.
examples: The clay baked in the sun.
They baked the electrical parts lightly to remove moisture.
It is baking in the greenhouse.
I'm baking after that workout in the gym.

senses.definition: (transitive, figuratively) To cause to be hot.
